svg.title: Janeway Hero Board — editable SVG
svg.desc: 4500 × 2700 px Janeway board. SVG icon geometry and editable text positioned against the approved raster hero-board composition. Original source artwork remains raster; all rules icons are vector.

g.inkscape:label: Name and quote
g.text: “Keep your shirt tucked in, go down with the ship,
and never abandon a member of your crew.”
